digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality sweep and Jira adapter architecture
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at package root to allow Data Center and Cloud backends to share the same mapper while keeping J7's sibling-adapter seal intact
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate the bidirectional sibling-adapter seal between jira and jira_datacenter packages
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core importers (inbound_differ.py and peer_state.py) cannot consume that layer
the module's by-path lazy-load of Cloud's adf.py cannot be routed through jira_family without laundering the AST contract gate
the backend-neutrality sweep exemption should document the permanent architectural reason for the root location rather than describe it as temporary relocation debt
